scheme_name: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Plan Growth
content: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Plan Growth Expense Ratio: The Total Expense Ratio (TER) for this direct growth plan is 1.21% (inclusive of GST). As a Direct Plan, it has a lower expense ratio compared to regular plans because no distributor commissions are paid.

scheme_name: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Plan Growth
content: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Plan Growth Exit Load: Nil. There is no exit load charged on redemption of units. Additionally, a mandatory stamp duty of 0.005% (from July 1st, 2020) applies on purchase of mutual fund units.

scheme_name: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Plan Growth
content: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Plan Growth Minimum Investment & SIP Amount: The minimum SIP investment amount is ₹500. The minimum lump-sum investment amount is ₹500, and the minimum additional investment is ₹500.

scheme_name: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Plan Growth
content: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Plan Growth Lock-in Period: This scheme has a statutory lock-in period of 3 years under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act. Investments cannot be redeemed, switched out, or withdrawn before the completion of 3 years from the date of unit allotment.

scheme_name: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Plan Growth
content: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Plan Growth Riskometer Classification: The scheme's risk level is classified as 'Very High' risk. Investors should understand that their principal investment will be at very high risk in this equity scheme.

scheme_name: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Plan Growth
content: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Plan Growth Benchmark Index: The scheme is benchmarked against the NIFTY 500 Total Return Index. The fund manager's portfolio composition and performance are measured against this index.

scheme_name: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Plan Growth
content: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Plan Growth Fund Managers: The fund is managed by Amar Kalkundrikar, Dhruv Muchhal. Amar Kalkundrikar (Mr. Kalkundrikar has done B.Com, CA, CFA, and MBA from Columbia Business School.) manages the portfolio.

scheme_name: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Plan Growth
content: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Plan Growth Scheme Overview: This is a direct growth plan in the ELSS equity category offered by HDFC Mutual Fund. The fund size (AUM) is approximately ₹15,991.78 Cr, and the Net Asset Value (NAV) is ₹1447.383 as of 25-Sep-2026.

scheme_name: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Plan Growth
content: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Plan Growth Taxation & Section 80C: Investments up to ₹1.5 lakh per financial year are eligible for tax deduction under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act. Long-term capital gains exceeding ₹1.25 lakh in a financial year are taxed at 12.5% without indexation.
